entities.summary: Alaa Murabit M.D. is a Libyan-Canadian physician, policy maker, and strategist focused on health, inclusive security, and sustainable development. In 2011, she created the Voice of Libyan Women at age 21 and played a key role in advancing multiple United Nations Security Council resolutions and the Sustainable Development Goals into global policy frameworks. In 2023, Murabit created For Mama, the first zakat-certified Muslim philanthropic collaborative for maternal and child health.
